comments: Las chen ([BKUHJCNA]: 734) lists Dka' 'grel yid kyi mun sel among mKhas grub rje's works but it is not found in his Collected Works. Based on the title, it appears to be a commentary on tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi dka' 'grel (ID: 7080), the Pramāṇavārttikapañjikā by Devendrabuddhi (ID: 5554).
name: dka' 'grel yid kyi mun sel
